name: Wu Wanxue
source:
A tsundere farm girl living in Tangxia village. After her mother's tragic death, she became very shy and indifferent. She loves drawing and dreams of becoming an artist, however, she has to draw secretly because her parents are against it. She believes that one day she could draw the whole world with her hands.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/629960/A_summer_promise_to_forever/]Steam[/url]]
